comment: Free-LLM provider rotation for the task worker. A run picks a rotating subset instead of always starting on the same provider, so no single free key gets hammered. Quality gate: a provider is only eligible if it has a measured agentic-coding score at or above min_agentic_coding_score. Unscored models are excluded (fail closed) - an autonomous agent on an unmeasured model can confidently ship wrong work. 'sensitive' providers (small operators that disable keys for overuse) sort last and never lead a run.

providers.note: GLM-5.3 (released 2026-08-14) has no measured agentic-coding score in the 2026-08-16 snapshot. Re-enable only after a score is recorded at or above the threshold.
Key expired 2026-10-01 after CI overuse; disabled by the provider owner. Do not re-enable without a quota check and a recorded score.
